T A Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), nestled in the academic town of Manipal, Karnataka, is a premier business school dedicated to shaping the future of management education. With a legacy built on academic rigor, industry relevance, and experiential learning, TAPMI is a hub for aspiring students, accomplished faculty, forward-thinking recruiters, and a thriving alumni network.

Recognized globally with prestigious accreditations from AACSB and AMBA, TAPMI upholds the highest standards of business education. The institute fosters a dynamic learning environment where innovation meets real-world application. Programs like the Summer Internship Program (SIP), Student Managed Investment Course (SMIC), Leadership Assessment and Development Centre (LADC), and BrandScan ensure that students gain hands-on experience and emerge industry-ready.

TAPMI is more than an institution; it is a center for thought leadership, cutting-edge research, and professional growth. It offers faculty an intellectually stimulating environment with opportunities for impactful research and collaboration. It serves as a talent powerhouse for recruiters, producing professionals with strategic vision and practical expertise. For alumni, it remains a lifelong partner in their professional journeys, fostering connections and continuous learning.

Rooted in the vision of its founder, Late Shri T A Pai, TAPMI continues to inspire generations of leaders who drive meaningful transformation in the corporate world and beyond. With an unwavering commitment to integrity, innovation, and excellence, TAPMI is redefining the future of management education.

About the Founder

Shri T M A Pai

Founder

Shri Tonse Madhava Ananth Pai (1898–1979) was an Indian physician, educationist, banker, and philanthropist who pivotally transformed Manipal into a central educational hub. In 1953, he established Kasturba Medical College, India’s first private, self-financing medical institution offering MBBS degrees. He later founded the Manipal Institute of Technology (1957) and other institutions, including the Manipal College of Dental Sciences and the Manipal College of Pharmaceutical Sciences.

Shri Pai co-founded Syndicate Bank in Udupi, Karnataka, alongside his brother Upendra Ananth Pai. He introduced the Pigmy Deposit Scheme, a groundbreaking initiative that encouraged small savings among the public.

In recognition of his contributions, the Indian government honored him with the Padma Shri in 1972. A commemorative stamp was issued in his name in 1999.

Shri T A Pai

Founder

Shri T A Pai (1922–1981) was an Indian banker and parliamentarian. He entered politics in 1972 as a Rajya Sabha member and served as Union Minister for Railways, Heavy Industries, Steel, Mines, Industry, and Civil Supplies. He won the Udupi Lok Sabha seat in 1977. Shri Pai was instrumental in the success of Syndicate Bank, where he served as general manager and later chairman. He founded the Manipal Institute of Management (MIM), which was renamed the T A Pai Management Institute (TAPMI) after his untimely demise. He was the first chairman of IIM Bangalore.

Shri Pai received the Padma Bhushan (1972) and honorary doctorates from Karnataka University (1973) and Andhra University (1975).

MAHE - History and Legacy

Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), established in 1953 by Shri T M A Pai, is a private deemed university in Karnataka, India. It started with India’s first private medical school, Kasturba Medical College (KMC), and expanded in 1957 with the Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT). Initially, degrees were awarded by Karnataka University, then by the University of Mysore and Mangalore University. In 1993, the University Grants Commission (UGC) granted MAHE deemed university status.

 

MAHE has multiple campuses in India, including Mangalore, Bengaluru, and Jamshedpur; the institution offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across health sciences, engineering, management, and humanities. It has received recognition as an “Institution of Eminence” by the Government of India and is known for its research and academic excellence.

Mission

To excel in management education, research and practice.

Means:

  • By nurturing and developing global wealth creators and leaders.
  • By continually benchmarking ourselves against the best in class institutions.
  • By fostering continuous learning and reflection, achievement orientation, creative interdependence and respect for diversity.

Prospective PhD candidates need to complete the online application form available on the TAPMI website. The application requires:

  • Academic transcripts and certificates (Undergraduate & Postgraduate).
  • Statement of Purpose (SOP) outlining research interests, motivation, and career goals.
  • Research Proposal or concept note on a proposed area of study.
  • Resume (CV) detailing academic and professional achievements.
